stem: Which of the following is an important theme in the story “Grandfather’s Legacy”?

options.label: A
options.text: By paying careful attention to details, one can easily master any challenge.

options.label: B
options.text: When people honor animals, they also honor themselves and their culture.

options.label: C
options.text: By sharing artistic skill and knowledge, people connect across generations.

options.label: D
options.text: Everyone has a special talent, but it sometimes takes a long time to find it.
